searchText: Do I understand correctly that "Interop" sections in updated network spec are related to a multiclient test network that we're aiming to have in October? It’s what I’m targeting for initial libp2p interop in September to get ready for longer standing testnets in October +1 https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/pull/1328 as sep interop target
